Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience directly working with insurance carriers on healthcare authorizations, referrals, or benefit verifications.
Direct experience handling insurance appeals, complex claim resolutions, and denial management workflows.
Demonstrated experience utilizing Epic or a comparable electronic health record system along with standard Microsoft Office applications.
Duties include, but are not limited to:
Submit prior authorization requests to health plans and managed care organizations for outpatient specialty services, diagnostic testing, procedures, and medications.
Track, follow up on, and document authorization statuses within the Epic electronic health record system to ensure care continuity.
Verify patient insurance eligibility and benefits while maintaining precise compliance with payer guidelines and departmental policies.
Process high-volume authorization workloads (30+ daily) while meeting critical turnaround standards for routine and STAT requests.
Thorough knowledge of medical terminology, commercial and managed care insurance plans, and payer guidelines.
Specialized knowledge of Medicare, Medi-Cal, PPO, HMO, and managed care authorization requirements and guidelines.
Familiarity with UCI Health operational workflows and Epic work queue monitoring.
